notes:
# Waymark 0.5.2

- Reduce minimap traffic by excluding unused regional outlines and sending individual spawn positions only when Spawn dots is enabled.
- Avoid rebuilding pet marker data when the observed pet snapshot has not changed. Cache map grouping and skip drawing markers outside the current map view.
- Give the background reader lower scheduling priority than the foreground game. Add an adaptive pause after terrain matching so expensive visual scans leave more CPU time for play; packet-based soul collection remains independent.
- Preserve the farming pockets, location data, filters, saved preferences and player glow from the previous build.
